note: Controlled test designs. Each entry names the artwork file, the physical size to digitize it at, and what a clean stitch-out of it proves. Both the regression suite and the browser fixture runner read this file.

designs.name: Single colour square
designs.proves: Basic fill in one colour with no colour change. Establishes the density and registration baseline everything else is compared against.

designs.name: Two colour logo
designs.proves: Exactly one colour change: the machine stops, the operator re-threads, and stitching resumes in register.

designs.name: Multi colour logo
designs.proves: Several colour changes and colour grouping across separated areas.

designs.name: Holes and cut-outs
designs.proves: Fills with holes. The needle must travel around openings rather than stitching across them.

designs.name: Narrow satin bars
designs.proves: Narrow shapes become satin columns with square ends and constant width, and hold at width on fabric.

designs.name: Detailed badge
designs.proves: The realistic worst case: layered areas, small counters, a colour used then returned to, and a higher stitch count with more trims.
